key_insight: Detonation-spraying parameters can tune the roughness, thickness, and hydrophobicity of titanium-dioxide-based coatings.
engineering_relevance: The reported relationships can guide spray-condition selection to improve coating water repellency while managing thickness and surface texture.
method: Vary detonation-spraying conditions, including nozzle passage speed and spray distance.
Evaluate coating roughness, thickness, and water contact angle.
Derive predictive equations and identify conditions for maximum hydrophobicity.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports inverse-power relationships between nozzle passage speed and roughness or thickness, and parabolic relationships between spray distance and roughness or contact angle.
watch_item: The abstract provides no numerical process ranges, fit accuracy, or validation details, limiting assessment of the equations' transferability.
paper_title: Surface Characteristics of Titanium Based Coatings Obtained by Detonation Spraying Under Various Process Conditions
